To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) trust in a customer can be built by linking transactions using the same purse, 2) this linking is a privacy threat, 3) we can reduce the threat without preventing trust-based payment by giving the user a way to control the linking, and 4) the control can be based on context.
the proposed scheme allows to enhance ubiquitous payment with trust while limiting privacy loss.
we have designed and implemented a system for enhancing trust-based e-payment in ubicomp environments that allows users to maintain their privacy while still benefiting from trust.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and validation of a trust-based model for payment in ubiquitous environments that is privacy-friendly.
the design of an enhanced ubiquitous payment system, which is based on a new approach to trust management.

the design, implementation and evaluation of an architecture for trust enhanced ubiquitous payment that mitigates privacy loss due to global profiling while allowing the user to divide transactions according to context.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
trust is a means for privacy, and that privacy can be preserved while allowing trust-based transactions.
our scheme is a good compromise between privacy and trust in ubiquitous payment.
trust and privacy are complementary, not contradictory.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the use of trust in payment systems can be done in a way that preserves privacy.
we propose a scheme that mitigates the privacy loss due to the use of trust in payment systems.
we propose a solution to the trade-off between trust and privacy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of context can be a means to reduce privacy loss without affecting the use of trust.
it is feasible to design a payment system that allows the use of trust while preserving privacy.
trust can be used in ubiquitous payment systems to smooth payment and to protect privacy.
